about:
SOLERS-PI Inc. is headquartered in New Berlin, Wisconsin. The company operates as the U.S. subsidiary of SOLERS, which was renamed from Progressive Image Inc. on August 1, 2021. SOLERS specializes in the development and engineering of cable assemblies and harnesses, serving as an independent manufacturer or in direct partnership with customers.

The company designs and produces customized cable assemblies and harnesses for manufacturers of state-of-the-art electronic and electrical equipment. Its processes include CAD systems that minimize development time and support remote drawing and data exchange during approval, along with state-of-the-art production methodologies. In 2024, SOLERS expanded its New Berlin workshop by approximately 850 square meters to accommodate additional capital equipment and engineering staff. Previous expansions include a capability upgrade at its Bar-Lev Industrial Zone facility in Israel (2023) and a 1,450-square-meter workshop addition at its Zhongshan, China site (2022).

SOLERS serves manufacturers of advanced electronic and electrical equipment that require highly customized cable assemblies and harnesses. The company works directly with these manufacturers as an independent supplier or as an engineering partner.

SOLERS emphasizes implemented work processes and procedures to meet the highest quality standards expected by customers and certification bodies. Its stated goals are to reduce assembly time, minimize failure rates, and safeguard electrical and mechanical performance, delivering customized solutions quickly and cost-effectively.
